claim: Poke the game's state (start room, stage byte) to reach rooms and stages cheaply, but use play recordings for collision numbers because poked states can place figures inside scenery.

evidence.text: Dan spawned by poke gives a room census for coverage (169 of 736,272 cells over scenery in the census); recordings give the clash numbers.
Poking 0xFFDF just after the start reaches a later stage.
